name: RC-B10-0074/2025 – Recital G – Am 1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Russia’s disinformation and historical falsification to justify its war of aggression against Ukraine
part_text: G.whereas Russia has failed to acknowledge the unforgivable initial role of the Soviet Union in the early stages of World War II, for example through the 1939 Treaty of Non-Aggression between Nazi Germany and the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics (Soviet Union) and its secrets protocols, commonly referred to as the Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact of 1939, in which both totalitarian regimes conspired to divide Europe into exclusive spheres of influence; whereas in 1938, the United Kingdom and France signed the Munich Agreement with Nazi Germany, excluding the Soviet Union from the negotiations; whereas this effectively allowed Hitler to annex the Sudetenland and invade the sovereign state of Czechoslovakia;
